ale_3.7_2: The quartermaster asked Bastian Ale to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Bastian Ale could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Bastian Ale tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Bastian Ale helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Bastian Ale fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Wendel Raymond was badly wounded. Bastian Ale ate breakfast without a word. A letter from home found Bastian Ale before the night shift. Bastian Ale folded it small and kept it close.
Bastian Ale and Jonas Nicolassuess carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.

Bastian Ale watched the enemy lines change the guard at S-R14 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Marek "Brick" Buddy was grazed. Bastian Ale raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-R14. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Rafael Warhamster of the Concord (@warhamster4).
The medics cleaned Bastian Ale's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-R14.
Bastian Ale found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
A dog crosses no man's land at the Chalk Pits every night, fed by Walter Muzio on one side and Bastian Ale on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy.
Bastian moved his hide three times today. Snipers who stay in one place do not stay anywhere for long.
always_out_front: Roland Front came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Roland Front kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Roland Front brought back a wounded man and a lost machine gun from the Brickworks in one trip. He is Lance Corporal now. After the loss of Grey Mill, Roland Front helped stack spare sandbags at T-S9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Roland Front in the open at T-S9. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel of the Hegemony (@thembamstel). Roland Front was killed on watch at T-S9. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel of the Hegemony (@thembamstel).
Clement Front put a lucky button beside the bunk. Someone who had known Roland Front helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Clement Front went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Clement Front fired, and Severin Drowning was grazed.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Clement Front shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Severin Drowning, was badly wounded.
Brass cases piled up around Clement Front's boots at T-S9. Out of all those rounds, one found Teodor "Owl" Passing, grazed.
Clement Front wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
Clement counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Teodor "Owl" Passing was grazed.
buff_kitty85: On Day 5 Hugo Kitty took a post at S-F22 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He can fall asleep anywhere, instantly, and the men liked him for it.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Hugo Kitty tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F22 is up. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Kitty. Hugo Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 is lost. Hugo Kitty heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Hugo Kitty fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Albin Weyer, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Kitty. Hugo Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

At Hill 304, Hugo Kitty and Ivo "Bones" Rylan exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Kitty. Hugo Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet clipped Hugo Kitty's helmet at S-F22 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Rafael Broadshoulde of the Hegemony (@broadshoulderedbastard). Dawn watch. Hugo Kitty put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Bastian "Crow" Jwger, badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Kitty. Hugo Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Machine-gun fire swept S-F22. Hugo Kitty took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Cyril Miller of the Hegemony (@ryder_miller11). Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Kitty. Hugo Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The medics called Hugo Kitty 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Hugo Kitty is back on the line. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Hugo Kitty wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Kitty. Hugo Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A round came through the loophole Hugo Kitty was watching at S-F22 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Roland Lovelightnin of the Hegemony (@i_lovelightning420). Hugo Kitty saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Wendel "Whistle" Gonzo, badly wounded. Hugo Kitty was killed at S-F22 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Roland Lovelightnin of the Hegemony (@i_lovelightning420).

Another member of the House of Kitty reached the line: Silas Kitty. He asked where Hugo Kitty had slept, then chose a different corner. The clerk counted the names twice. Silas Kitty is number 349 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Silas Kitty watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

A bullet went through Silas Kitty's upper arm at S-F22 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Tobias Pilot of the Hegemony (@boeing_b17_pilot_). Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Kitty. Silas Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Silas Kitty drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Kitty. Silas Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The stretcher Silas Kitty lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Silas Kitty is back at S-F22, and someone else is lying in that dent now. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Kitty. Silas Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A round went through Silas Kitty's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Severin "Crow" Boy of the Hegemony (@st0nk_boy). Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Kitty. Silas Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Silas Kitty was carrying water up to S-F22 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Silas Kitty did not. Shot by Tobias Pilot of the Hegemony (@boeing_b17_pilot_).

Silas Kitty's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. Silas Kitty was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door. Silas Kitty got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.
The worst has passed for Silas. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly.
cesare_borgia5076: Viktor "Crow" Borgia came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Viktor "Crow" Borgia was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at Q-F14. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul of the Concord (@shimmapaul). The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Viktor "Crow" Borgia folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Viktor "Crow" Borgia walked back up the communication trench to Q-F14, slower than before, but on his own feet. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Viktor "Crow" Borgia watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Viktor "Crow" Borgia across the shin at Q-F14. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Albin Ikanbili of the Concord (@ikanbili_s).

A bullet went through Viktor "Crow" Borgia's upper arm at Q-F14 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Karel Izaya of the Concord (@ronin_izaya). Viktor "Crow" Borgia was killed at Q-F14 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Karel Izaya of the Concord (@ronin_izaya).
The papers say Dorian Borgia. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Viktor "Crow" Borgia's eyes. Nobody in Q-F14 argues.
Dorian Borgia raised his head for a heartbeat too long at Q-F14. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft of the Concord (@brouwer_airsoft).
Dorian Borgia was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at Q-F14. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Marek Brycetom of the Concord (@brycetom03).
Dorian Borgia healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
A loose thread in Dorian Borgia's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
Dorian kept watch so that Dietrich Juliofck could sleep. Then Dietrich kept watch so that Dorian could. Neither slept.
crabesquash: By the time Teodor Crabesquash reached M-F11, the war was 15 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Teodor Crabesquash kept watch so that Karel "Saint" Jarosztyler could sleep. Then Saint kept watch so that Teodor could. Neither slept.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Teodor Crabesquash closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Teodor did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Teodor fired back. Quentin Gingy was grazed.
david_mtzrn: After 9 days of war, Q-F17 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Isidor Mtzrn.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Isidor Mtzrn watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

The bread had frozen at the edges. Isidor Mtzrn held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Isidor Mtzrn wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Isidor Mtzrn put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.

Isidor Mtzrn raised his head for a heartbeat too long at Q-F17. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Bastian Hat of the Hegemony (@__mr.hat__). Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Valentin "Spark" Vergel stood up to sing louder, and Isidor Mtzrn fired. Valentin "Spark" Vergel was grazed. The singing stopped.
Isidor Mtzrn came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
Isidor Mtzrn offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Isidor Mtzrn waited for that to change. When it did, Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto was grazed.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Isidor Mtzrn changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Isidor thought about his mother, who writes every Sunday on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
dooka_the_shitter: Nobody asked Wendel Shitter why he came. Nobody in P-F1 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Wendel Shitter has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Wendel Shitter wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Wendel Shitter could not stop listening to it.

Wendel Shitter was hit in the forearm at P-F1. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Hugo Baroosal of the Hegemony (@baroosal).
A bullet struck Wendel Shitter below the ribs at P-F1. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Walter Stjohn of the Hegemony (@alex_stjohn_).
No bed for Wendel Shitter yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Wendel Shitter survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at P-F1, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
Wendel Shitter had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Roland Earn crossed it, Wendel Shitter fired. Roland Earn was badly wounded.
Wendel waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Gustav Levi did, and was badly wounded.
dromichete: The old hands of V-F1 have been here since Day 1. Valentin Dromichete has been here since Day 17. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
A flare lit Verdel Ridge like noon. Valentin counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
emotionless_android: On Day 10, Arno "Brick" Android arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Arno "Brick" Android and Norbert Cheese argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. A letter from home reached Arno "Brick" Android before dusk. Arno "Brick" Android read it twice and slept a little easier. Arno "Brick" Android asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a sniper. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Arno "Brick" Android folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

The men have learned that Arno "Brick" Android polishes his buttons every evening. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal. A letter from home reached Arno "Brick" Android before dusk. Arno "Brick" Android read it twice and slept a little easier.
Arno "Brick" Android tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.

Arno "Brick" Android spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at Q-F7 is closed now. A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Arno "Brick" Android aimed a step ahead and fired: Roland "Doc" This, badly wounded. A letter from home reached Arno "Brick" Android before dusk. Arno "Brick" Android read it twice and slept a little easier.

Arno "Brick" Android tried to describe the smell of Port Abel and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. A letter from home reached Arno "Brick" Android before dusk. Arno "Brick" Android read it twice and slept a little easier.

Arno "Brick" Android joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. The letter for Arno "Brick" Android asked if the food was good. Arno "Brick" Android wrote back that it was. That was a lie, but a kind one.

Arno "Brick" Android had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Edmund Raptor was gravely wounded. Arno "Brick" Android got a letter with a recipe in it. Nobody in the trench had any of the things it needed.

Arno made a hat out of grass and burlap and wore it for the whole shift. Even the squad could not find him. A friendly letter reached Arno from a nurse who had once treated his father. Arno did not know what to make of it, and kept it.
francisflute: Nils "Spark" Francisflute introduced himself as a coal miner from Brennmoor. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Nils "Spark" Francisflute's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.

Night raid. Nils "Spark" Francisflute crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Nils "Spark" Francisflute. Back from the raid, Nils "Spark" Francisflute found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Hello' (common). Nobody asked where it came from.
Silas Jarkusrodan taught Nils "Spark" Francisflute to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
A second spoon disappeared. Nils searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
jawir_edgy_irony_media: Dorian Media reported to R-S17 with a book with the last pages torn out sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Dorian Media of the Concord lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at the Hanging Bridge. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias's name scratched on the lid.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Dorian Media heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Dorian Media ran a message through the communication trench under shellfire. The message said: 'Hold.' A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Dorian Media is number 596. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Dorian Media watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Dorian Media raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-S17. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko of the Hegemony (@lancegribko).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Dorian Media is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Dorian Media delivered an urgent message and waited while the officer searched every pocket for a pencil to sign for it.
Albin "Spark" Bananarail fell asleep on watch. Dorian Media took over without waking Spark, and told the sergeant nothing.

A bullet hit Dorian Media in the neck at R-S17. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko of the Hegemony (@lancegribko). Dorian Media stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-S17. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko of the Hegemony (@lancegribko).
The papers say Leopold "Ash" Media. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Dorian Media's eyes. Nobody in R-S17 argues.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Leopold "Ash" Media and Florian Danielmcmena exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.

A bullet hit Leopold's belt buckle at R-S17 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Jonas Hill of the Hegemony (@_strawberry.hill_). Leopold rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Emil Yijoon was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
jcsv2305: Casimir Jcsv came up on Day 9 carrying news from Port Abel. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

A bullet struck Casimir Jcsv below the ribs at R-R9. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Konrad Daami of the Concord (@daami_nt). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Casimir Jcsv helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Casimir Jcsv lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant. A letter from home reached Casimir Jcsv before dusk. Casimir Jcsv read it twice and slept a little easier. Casimir Jcsv got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 991. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Casimir Jcsv did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Casimir Jcsv healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving. A letter from home reached Casimir Jcsv before dusk. Casimir Jcsv read it twice and slept a little easier.

The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Casimir Jcsv spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open. A letter from home reached Casimir Jcsv before dusk. Casimir Jcsv read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Casimir Jcsv tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-R9 is up. A letter from home reached Casimir Jcsv before dusk. Casimir Jcsv read it twice and slept a little easier.

The section held a competition for the worst joke. Casimir Jcsv won before reaching the end of his entry. A letter from home reached Casimir Jcsv before dusk. Casimir Jcsv read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Jcsv threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Dietrich Samhatespeac was down and screaming for a medic. (@samhatespeace) The flare went up just as Casimir Jcsv reached the Concord parapet. Casimir Jcsv jumped down first. Teodor Yaboypolarbe was the man waiting there, and Teodor Yaboypolarbe fell. (@yaboypolarbear) The letter for Casimir Jcsv ended with 'come home soon'. Casimir Jcsv read the last line more than the rest.

Casimir Jcsv had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate crossed it, Casimir Jcsv fired. Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate was grazed. A letter reached Casimir Jcsv with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Casimir Jcsv tried to as well.

A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Casimir's bunk. He has named it Captain. There was a letter for Casimir that smelled of pipe smoke. Casimir knew at once who had written it, and smiled for the first time all week.
lelio_benvenuti: Day 11: Henrik Benvenuti reached U-F4 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Henrik Benvenuti folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Henrik Benvenuti as a story about a general. The ending was the same.

Henrik Benvenuti was hit in the foot through his boot at U-F4. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Albin Tomvandeloos of the Concord (@tomvandeloosdrecht). Henrik Benvenuti was hit at U-F4 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Albin Tomvandeloos of the Concord (@tomvandeloosdrecht).
Quentin Benvenuti had heard about Henrik Benvenuti's courage. At U-F4, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Quentin Benvenuti had just lit a cigarette at U-F4 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Dietrich Dagata of the Concord (@anthony.dagata).
Quentin Benvenuti is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Quentin Benvenuti held the mirror while Dietrich "Spark" Geddy shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Quentin Benvenuti smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Rafael Daddy came out for a cup and was badly wounded.
Henrik "Smokes" Missyandloga and Quentin Benvenuti compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
m0c_sam0: Ulrich "Smokes" Sam came up the line with a frozen apple and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Ulrich "Smokes" Sam saw Silas Kmec freeze up on the fire step at the Brickworks. Smokes said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.

Night raid. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Ulrich "Smokes" Sam. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Ulrich "Smokes" Sam could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich "Smokes" Sam. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam became a chaplain today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Ulrich "Smokes" Sam tells terrible jokes. Today, under fire at the Brickworks, that habit was the only steady thing in S-S2. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich "Smokes" Sam. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The clerk counted the names twice. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam is number 601 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The old Private did not come back from the wire. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam wears his stripes now: Lance Corporal.

Ulrich "Smokes" Sam held a service beside a ration store. The men sang quietly so the sleepers behind the wall could rest. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich "Smokes" Sam. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ulrich "Smokes" Sam wrote letters for men who could not write, and some for men who could but did not know the words. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich "Smokes" Sam. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ulrich "Smokes" Sam was carrying water up to S-S2 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam did not. Shot by Roland "Mole" Tuckerdesave of the Concord (@tuckerdesaveur).

Ulrich "Smokes" Sam drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. A letter reached Ulrich "Smokes" Sam with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam tried to as well.

The medics called Ulrich "Smokes" Sam 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam is back on the line. The censor had blacked out two words in the letter for Ulrich "Smokes" Sam. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam guessed what they were and laughed. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam reported for duty as a machine gunner. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
Ulrich and Tobias Pilot built a small shelf out of a cracker box. It holds two mugs, a candle and one shared hope.
mugginsthedestroyer: Emil "Button" Mugginsthede arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in R-C6 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Emil "Button" Mugginsthede came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Emil "Button" Mugginsthede during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil "Button" Mugginsthede. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The medic looked at Emil "Button" Mugginsthede's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-C6. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil "Button" Mugginsthede. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede answered to number 646. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Dawn watch. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Karel Bachini, badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil "Button" Mugginsthede. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Emil "Button" Mugginsthede was hit in the forearm at R-C6. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Leopold Romania of the Concord (@greater.romania).

Wiring party. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at R-C6, and everyone came back. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede rejoined the squad at R-C6. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil "Button" Mugginsthede. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Two men fed the belt while Emil "Button" Mugginsthede held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Florian Warrior was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil "Button" Mugginsthede. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede landed next to Felix "Brick" Eddie in the Concord trench. Only Emil "Button" Mugginsthede climbed back out. (@eduard._.eddie) Emil "Button" Mugginsthede counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Arno "Lucky" Yokley never saw the shovel coming. (@brock_yokley)

Emil "Button" Mugginsthede fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Silas Donnyredd, now grazed. A bullet hit Emil "Button" Mugginsthede in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-C6. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Wendel Hans of the Concord (@lezu_hans).

No bed ever came for Emil. A tired medic changed the dressing at dawn and again at dusk until the wound was clean. Then he went back to work. The letter for Emil had only one line: 'Come home soon.' Emil read it more times than a one-line letter should be read.
qhmullaney: "You're late," said the corporal when Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Hugo "Lucky" Ayangd, grazed. The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-R6, Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney is number 880. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-R6. Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney has learned to walk bent double.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney found a chair in the barn and sat down carefully, as if it might be reserved for someone of higher rank.
Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Walter Thehuman came out for a cup and was grazed.
Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney fired at a movement across the wire at R-R6. The man went down: Isidor Person, badly wounded.
Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney fired back. Pavel Finnius was badly wounded.
On dawn watch at R-R6, Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Casimir Shi, now badly wounded.
Yann had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Marek Hayden, grazed.
sideofjalapenoseh: Nils Sideofjalape took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Nils stayed on the fire step for two hours so the sentries could eat. Nobody had asked him.
simplepach_wt: Day 9: Gustav Simplepach reached S-R4 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Gustav Simplepach read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Gustav Simplepach's ear at S-R4 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe of the Hegemony (@castlecrasher1). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Gustav Simplepach is number 956. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is lost. Gustav Simplepach heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Gustav Simplepach was carrying water up to S-R4 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Gustav Simplepach did not. Shot by Henrik "Shadow" Soccer of the Hegemony (@cuyler_soccer26). Gustav Simplepach was killed at S-R4 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Henrik "Shadow" Soccer of the Hegemony (@cuyler_soccer26).
Rafael "Saint" Simplepach had heard about Gustav Simplepach's courage. At S-R4, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Fog hid the far end of S-R4. Rafael "Saint" Simplepach kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout.

Rafael "Saint" Simplepach was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-R4. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Casimir Schradog of the Hegemony (@schradog2).
A bullet found Rafael "Saint" Simplepach at S-R4, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls of the Hegemony (@bri3kcls).
A medic brought Rafael "Saint" Simplepach half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
Rafael "Saint" Simplepach healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.

Rafael went down at S-R4 with a wound that would not stop bleeding. The medic used a belt, a scarf and a shoelace. Shot by Silas "Bones" Hunterplum of the Hegemony (@hunterplum). Rafael fell at S-R4 with a bullet in the head. He had been laughing a moment before.
Bram Simplepach asked about Rafael "Saint" Simplepach on arriving at S-R4. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
stoicsfc: Albin "Rabbit" Stoicsfc came from Dunmarrow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Albin "Rabbit" Stoicsfc took the long way round Grey Mill because the short way had a sniper on it. The long way had two.
Albin "Rabbit" Stoicsfc had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
Albin saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
strikafrom_lusaka: Casimir "Owl" Lusaka, a shepherd from Rosenau, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in Q-F18. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Casimir "Owl" Lusaka wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Casimir "Owl" Lusaka offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once. After the loss of Grey Mill, Casimir "Owl" Lusaka helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F18. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Ivo Banach stood up to sing louder, and Casimir "Owl" Lusaka fired. Ivo Banach was badly wounded. The singing stopped.
Casimir "Owl" Lusaka had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Roland "Hollow" Mekli crossed it, Casimir "Owl" Lusaka fired. Roland "Hollow" Mekli was badly wounded.
Casimir "Owl" Lusaka fired at the enemy dawn watch from Q-F18. Walter Thefreakones was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
A bullet grazed Casimir "Owl" Lusaka's ribs at Q-F18. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Dietrich Drak of the Hegemony (@glauber.drak).
The medic cut the last bandage off Casimir "Owl" Lusaka's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to Q-F18 the same hour.
Casimir "Owl" Lusaka fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at Q-F18. Before dawn Wendel Mekli walked into it, grazed.
Casimir gave Valentin Peebles the dry end of the bunk and took the wet one. Valentin Peebles noticed and said, quietly, that they would swap tomorrow.
warhamster4: The draft reached S-F18 on Day 3. Albin Warhamster was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

A clear shot from S-F18. Albin Warhamster grazed Emil Ghostbebrii and slid back down below the parapet. Now serving as a sniper, Albin Warhamster discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Albin Warhamster went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. A letter from home found Albin Warhamster before the night shift. Albin Warhamster folded it small and kept it close.

Albin Warhamster spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-F18 is closed now. Albin Warhamster fired at a movement across the wire at S-F18. The man went down: Florian "Button" Thebaileebla, badly wounded. A letter from home found Albin Warhamster before the night shift. Albin Warhamster folded it small and kept it close. Hill 304 is lost. Albin Warhamster heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Albin Warhamster dreamt he was back in Ashford Vale, working as a postman. He woke up and said nothing all morning. A letter from home found Albin Warhamster before the night shift. Albin Warhamster folded it small and kept it close.

Albin Warhamster raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F18. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Jakub Lilsaint of the Hegemony (@carlos_lilsaint_). A letter from home found Albin Warhamster before the night shift. Albin Warhamster folded it small and kept it close.

Albin Warhamster's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. A letter from home found Albin Warhamster before the night shift. Albin Warhamster folded it small and kept it close.
Face blackened with soot, Albin Warhamster spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki was gravely wounded.

Albin Warhamster threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Konrad "Crow" Dinhdong was down and screaming for a medic. (@dinhdong234) The Hegemony sentry, Jakub Lilsaint, shouted once. Albin Warhamster silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@carlos_lilsaint_) A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F18. Albin Warhamster was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Jakub Lilsaint of the Hegemony (@carlos_lilsaint_).

A letter came with Rafael Warhamster: "I am Albin Warhamster's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. The new duty roster listed Rafael Warhamster as a machine gunner. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Rafael Warhamster had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Emil Ghostbebrii crossed it, Rafael Warhamster fired. Emil Ghostbebrii was badly wounded. A letter from home found Rafael Warhamster before the night shift. Rafael Warhamster folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Rafael Warhamster answered to number 198. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Rafael Warhamster read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Rafael Warhamster fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias was grazed. Rafael Warhamster ate breakfast without a word. A bullet hit the sandbag next to Rafael Warhamster's ear at S-F18 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Florian Carterdelaru of the Hegemony (@carterdelaruelle).
Rafael Warhamster returned to S-F18 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Rafael Warhamster tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at P-F9 is up. Rafael Warhamster fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Bastian Ale was grazed.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Rafael Warhamster. The men named it Old Tom and said it had chosen him.

Rafael Warhamster went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Roland Josiascouper was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@josiascouper) Rafael Warhamster came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir.
Old Tom the crow follows Rafael Warhamster along the trench now. When Old Tom flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
Rafael fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Jonas Nicolassuess was grazed trying to cross it.
